summary: Read-only verification of the round-2 fixes in LIVE mode. No calls were placed, no settings were saved, no campaigns were launched, the call mode was not toggled and test_rpi_v2.py was not run. 28/28 pytest passed (16 new in test_round2_fixes.py plus 12 regression tests in test_recordings_voice.py). (1) bn-IN and hi-IN confirmed_close now carry the new purpose restatement. No confirmed_close in any language contains representative/प्रतिनिधि/প্রতিনিধি. prompt-preview for West Bengal returns bn-IN, and its system_prompt has the 'Never promise that a representative' rule and the new Bengali close. (2) Dispositions include FINAL_DENIAL_CLOSING with label 'Final Denial Closing', and unreached_disposition is FINAL_DENIAL_CLOSING. Mongo has 0 contacts and 0 call_attempts with 'Final Denial Closing'. (3) preview-name for 'Surath Dey' returns সুরথ দে for bn-IN, सुरथ डे for hi-IN and 'Surath Dey' unchanged for en-IN. Empty names and invalid languages return 400. spoken_name override logic: a word override gives 'Surath দে', a full-name override wins even with auto-transliteration on, and an override in a different language is ignored. (4) The export for both campaigns has exactly the 14 expected columns (with BOM). Category and Summary are filled for completed rows, Transcript parses as a JSON list, and the Recording link returns 200 audio/wav. (5) build_vapi_payload with spoken_name সুরথ দে puts it in firstMessage and in the system prompt, while customer.name stays 'Surath Dey'. UI: the pronunciation section, auto switch, editor row (pron-add/name/language/spoken) and preview (result সুরথ দে) all work. disposition-code-4 shows FINAL_DENIAL_CLOSING / Final Denial Closing. The script textareas show the new bn and hi text. The campaign KPI card shows 'Final Denial Closing 0', and the filter tab FINAL_DENIAL_CLOSING filters correctly. No page errors.

minor.issue: Uses the raw ?name value instead of spoken_name(), so the preview shows 'Surath Dey' in the Bengali prompt while a real call would use 'সুরথ দে'. This is a preview/real-call mismatch only.

issues: The preview widget calls the server with the SAVED settings, so pronunciation rows added but not yet saved are not reflected. Add a hint ('save to apply overrides') or send the draft overrides in the preview request.

action_items: Optional: make prompt-preview use cs.spoken_name() (or a flag) so the preview matches the live prompt
Optional: let preview-name accept draft pronunciation_overrides, or show a 'save to apply' hint
critical_code_review_comments: place_call awaits an LLM transliteration call inline in the worker before each uncached contact. That adds LLM latency per dial, and with max_concurrent_calls > 1 the dials are serialized. Consider pre-transliterating at CSV import time.
The spoken_names cache is keyed by language and name per contact. It is not invalidated when the auto-transliterate setting is turned off, but overrides are checked first, so it is acceptable.
